title: The Man Who Feared His Shadow
summary: A man was running breathlessly through the village, screaming that a dark phantom was pursuing his footsteps....
keywords: the man who feared his shadow
full_text:
A man was running breathlessly through the village, screaming that a dark phantom was pursuing his footsteps.

Nasruddin caught him by the shoulder, guided him under the broad shade of a great oak tree, and pointed to the ground: "Look! In the shade, your phantom disappears! Step out of the scorching heat of fear, and your shadow ceases to haunt you."
moral: Running from imaginary fears exhausts the runner; step into the shade of peace.
